claims.value: Undifferentiated, with little cytoplasm and few organelles, the basal cell is a stem cell that divides by mitosis to give rise to other epithelial cell types.
claims.quote: Undifferentiated; mitotic stem cell for other epithelial cell types; rounded or elliptical with little cytoplasm and few organelles

claims.value: In the epidermis, basal cells form a single layer of stem cells that constantly divide by mitosis, and every keratinocyte comes from them.
claims.quote: A basal cell is a cuboidal-shaped stem cell that is a precursor of the keratinocytes of the epidermis. All of the keratinocytes are produced from this single layer of cells, which are constantly going through mitosis to produce new cells.

source.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

tier1.text: Undifferentiated; mitotic stem cell for other epithelial cell types; rounded or elliptical with little cytoplasm and few organelles; contain cytokeratin intermediate filament.
